'''Chris McDaniel''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Virginia tournament]] on 19 August 2001 with Senators (Darth Maul Site), according to Devon Clark's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2882">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-22-richmond-va-8-19-01d2882/ richmond-va-8-19-01], DeckTech (Devon "Devonator" Clark, 22 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-22-richmond-va-8-19-01d2882/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
